evidence: knowledge_decay.py owns closed profiles and read-only assessment; temporal validity, persistence, lifecycle, and retrieval retain their existing owners.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep per-record freshness evidence in the next dedicated contract.

evidence: Retrieval consumes one recency score from the policy and the service exposes the same assessor without adding a database dependency.
dimensions.recommendation: Retain policy injection so future benchmarking can replace profiles without changing storage.

evidence: All memory types have a closed profile; assessments expose validity, profile mode, half-life, anchor, score, review status, and freshness availability.
dimensions.recommendation: Version profile semantics before adding record-level overrides.

evidence: No schema or memory row is changed; existing valid_from, valid_until, status, and supersession links remain authoritative.
dimensions.recommendation: Do not copy freshness assertions into unstructured payload fields.

evidence: Tests cover profile completeness, relative decay, supersession-only decisions, explicit validity, historical truth, retrieval integration, cache identity, and CLI reporting.
dimensions.recommendation: Add a temporal accuracy benchmark before claiming retrieval improvement.

evidence: Memory type is a coarse proxy and cannot distinguish volatile and durable facts within the same type.
impact_path: Two semantic facts have different real-world volatility.
One may decay too quickly or too slowly.
dimensions.recommendation: Prompt 116 should add verified per-record freshness without allowing content inference to grant durability.

evidence: Profiles, timestamps, validity precedence, and scores use deterministic local code with no model or network provider.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep model-based volatility classification outside the authority path.

evidence: The policy is injected into retrieval and owns no persistent schema, enabling benchmarked replacement.
dimensions.recommendation: Bump retrieval cache identity whenever scoring semantics change.

abstractions.purpose: Provide type-aware recency subordinate to explicit temporal validity and supersession.
use_evidence: Used by hybrid retrieval, AdaptiveRuntime assessment, and memory half-life CLI.
complexity_cost: One stateless policy module, four value types, retrieval integration, and a cache version bump.
abstractions.recommendation: Retain as the sole type-profile owner.
